title: Implement Request Body Parsing
description: This feature is crucial for handling JSON and URL-encoded request bodies, enabling yantraverse to support a wider range of APIs and applications. It will provide a built-in way to parse request bodies, making it easier for developers to work with data. This feature will improve the overall usability and flexibility of the framework
testCases: Test error handling for invalid request bodies
acceptance: Request body parsing should work correctly for JSON and URL-encoded bodies, and error handling should be implemented for invalid request bodies
reason: This feature is essential for supporting real-world use cases and improving the framework's competitiveness with other Node.js frameworks
